cap: Labor starts as a cascade. Placental corticotropin-releasing hormone drives fetal ACTH, the fetal adrenal makes DHEA-S, and the placenta turns it into estrogen, which lifts progesterone’s block and builds oxytocin receptors, prostaglandins and connexin 43 gap junctions. The Ferguson reflex keeps it going. Induction copies this with misoprostol, dinoprostone, a balloon after a cesarean, and oxytocin.
